description: Source code implementing ubus support for wpa_supplicant, including ubus connection management, BSS feature retrieval, WPS start/cancel, and event notification.

methods.name: get_wpa_global_from_object
methods.description: Inline function to retrieve wpa_global structure from ubus object.

methods.name: get_wpas_from_object
methods.description: Inline function to retrieve wpa_supplicant structure from ubus object.

methods.name: ubus_reconnect_timeout
methods.description: Handles ubus reconnection timeout and retries.

methods.name: wpas_ubus_connection_lost
methods.description: Callback for ubus connection loss, triggers reconnection.

methods.name: wpas_ubus_init
methods.description: Initializes ubus connection and event loop.

methods.name: wpas_ubus_ref_dec
methods.description: Decrements ubus context reference count and frees if zero.

methods.name: wpas_bss_get_features
methods.description: Retrieves supported features (HT, VHT) of a BSS.

methods.name: wpas_ubus_add_bss
methods.description: Adds a wpa_supplicant BSS object to ubus.

methods.name: wpas_ubus_free_bss
methods.description: Removes a wpa_supplicant BSS object from ubus.

methods.name: wpas_ubus_notify
methods.description: Sends WPS credential event notification via ubus.
